SYNTHETIC QA FIXTURE - FICTIONAL AGENCY AND PEOPLE - NOT AN OFFICIAL RECORD
Fictional Serai Civic Development Office
Circular CVD-26-17, version 1. Issued 14 September 2026.
Subject: Serai Civic Access Pilot, identifier SERAI-47.
The proposed public launch is 12 November 2026. The planning ceiling is RM 240,000. Three service counters are proposed. The intended pilot area is Taman Serai North.
Mira Tan is the programme lead. Arif Lim coordinates operations. The participating partner is the fictional Serai Transit Unit.
This circular is a proposal and does not constitute procurement approval.

SYNTHETIC QA FIXTURE - FICTIONAL AGENCY AND PEOPLE - NOT AN OFFICIAL RECORD
Rationale and dependencies
The proposal seeks to shorten the first-visit intake process for residents. Queue counts were not supplied, so no measured time-saving claim is established.
The proposed launch depends on an accessibility walkthrough and procurement clearance. The procurement clearance reference is not recorded.
Mira Tan must obtain the accessibility sign-off. No completion date for that sign-off is recorded in this version.
The unique filing keyword is SERAI-47-PLUM-KITE.
